# Analysis & visualisation pipeline (PostgreSQL era)

*Generated by Claude Fable 5 (Anthropic) — 2026-08-18. Supersedes the
MongoDB/InfluxDB description in `AGENTS.md` §4–7 (kept there for history).*

Everything a FISH capture produces lives in one `session_dir`
(`~/fish_traces/fish_<YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS>/`), and everything the host-side
pipeline derives lives in one PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB database (`fish`).

```
session_dir/                    host pipeline                          consumers
──────────────────────────      ────────────────────────────────────   ─────────────────────────
ros2/       LTTng CTF        →  postprocess/ingest_pg.py               ros2_trace (hypertable)
nsys/       *.nsys-rep+sqlite→        "                                nsys_* tables (kernels,
snapshot/   ros2 CLI dumps   →        "                                runtime, memcpy, sync …)
fishlog/    daemon logs,     →        "                                sessions, snapshot tables
            discards.txt,
            env.txt, launch_full.log
launch_components.json        →        "
                                postprocess/model_improved_pg.py   →   graph_nodes / graph_edges
                                postprocess/export_traces_tempo.py →   Tempo (spans for Grafana)
                                postprocess/fish_viz_server.py     →   :8783 web views (reads PG)
                                scripts/fish_dashboard_url.py      →   Grafana URL for the session
```

## 1. Ingest — `postprocess/ingest_pg.py <session_dir>`

* Reads the CTF trace with babeltrace2 and bulk-COPYs every event into
  `ros2_trace(ts_ns, session_id, event, cpu_id, vpid, vtid, procname, payload
  jsonb)`; ~18–20 K events/s (a 12 M-event per-instance session ≈ 11 min).
* nsys sqlite files → `nsys_kernels`, `nsys_runtime`, `nsys_memcpy`,
  `nsys_memset`, `nsys_sync`, `nsys_processes` with **absolute UTC `ts_ns`**.
  The session-start correction uses whole seconds from `utcTime` plus the
  sub-second fraction of `utcEpochNs` (ISSUE-004 in `notes/known_issues.txt`;
  without it every report is 0..999 ms off).
* snapshot/ (node info, topic info/hz, component list, ps tree, env.txt) and
  fishlog/ (discards, launch_full.log) are stored as tables/attributes of the
  `sessions` row.
* `--force` re-ingests an existing session id.

## 2. Model — `python3 -m postprocess.model_improved_pg --session <id> [--source-trace <dir>]`

Builds the 4-layer FISH graph (CN container / EX executor / N node / E entity /
F function) plus the horizontal (communication) edges, and saves it to
`graph_nodes` / `graph_edges` (`graph_store_pg.save_graph`, which now also
runs `ANALYZE` — a bulk save leaves stale planner statistics and the viz
queries degrade from seconds to tens of minutes without it).

Stages, in order (`extract()`):

| stage | what it derives |
|---|---|
| `identify_executors` / `identify_entities` / `identify_callbacks` | executors, nodes, entities (sub/pub/serv/client/timer/action/**Waitable**), F callbacks; two delivery paths per intra-process-capable subscription (`delivery = ipc \| dds \| both`, `ipc_waitable`, `alt_cb_addrs`) |
| `attribute_aspects` | publish/client/receive aspects of every callback (from `fish_rclcpp_*_link` events + NITROS links) |
| `detect_joins` | ≥2 sibling input callbacks publishing the same output → `join_group`, `join_role` (completer / member / timeout); ties drawn as `nature=join` |
| `detect_state_links` | **inferred** sample-and-hold links: deposit-only sub F → publishing F of the same node (`nature=state, inferred=True`) |
| `detect_polled_subs` | **observed** sample-and-hold links: an `rmw_take` (taken=1) inside another callback's window (Autoware `InterProcessPollingSubscriber` & co.) → sub F `polled=True`, edge `polled=True, inferred=False` |
| `attach_callback_groups` | callback group / executor membership (`fish_rclcpp_cbgroup_*`, `fish_rclcpp_executor_*`) |
| `mark_phases` | F phase ∈ data / init / zero_exec (polled subs count as data) |
| `detect_oort_threads`, `detect_actions` | GPU (nsys) thread ownership; action-server roles |
| `create_graph` + `add_horizontal_edges` | vertical containment + L3 msg/state/join edges, L2/L1/L0 aggregates, external boundary nodes (`ext:`) |
| `measure_flows` | per-instance numbers when `[trace] per_instance=true`: hop latency publish→take (`rmw_take` paired by DDS `source_timestamp`, or ipc time), data age of state edges (start-based for inferred, `take − source_ts` for polled) → `flow_n, hop_ns_p50/p90/max, age_ns_p50/p90/max, flow_method` |

Companion analyses:

* `postprocess/join_analysis.py --session <id>` — join structure, completer
  distribution, exec time by role, AND-join test, 1a/1b/2 classification
  (`notes/join_semantics_from_traces.txt`).
* `postprocess/extract_taskset.py` — flat taskset (F, executor, period, WCET,
  delivery, join role) as the seed of the SAG/Nasri emitter.
* `postprocess/gpu_coverage_check.py` — nsys clock-offset scan and
  cuda_runtime coverage.

## 3. Traces to Tempo — `postprocess/export_traces_tempo.py <session_id>`

Every (`callback_start`, `callback_end`) pair becomes an OTLP span
(service = process+pid, span name = entity label). Timestamps stay at real
session time; the script patches Tempo's block `meta.json` after the flush
(`reference: notes/known_issues.txt`, Tempo 3.0 vParquet4 start-time quirk)
so TraceQL search over the session window works.

## 4. Web views — `python3 postprocess/fish_viz_server.py --port 8783`

Reads PG only (start it once; it survives model rebuilds — reload the page).

| URL | view |
|---|---|
| `/?session_id=…&scope=__main__` | graph viewer (fish_graph.json of the session) |
| `/wcc?session_id=…` (FT view) | FISH tasks (weakly connected components over data edges) + namespace views; filters `infra`, `ext`, `neighbors`, `node`, `topic`; badges `[waitable:sub·ipc]`, `[sub·dds]`, `[sub·polled]`, `⋈role`; orange state edges (dashed inferred, solid polled) with data age; lazy SVG per FT |
| `/components?session_id=…` | Layer B component graph (top-level namespaces; links trigger / sampled / join / infra with p50 hop or age; `depth`, `infra`, `crosscut`, `ext=split\|merge`) |
| `/gantt-tid`, `/gantt-cb`, `/cb-stats` | per-thread and per-callback Gantt, callback statistics |
| `/api/taskset`, `/api/task-graphs`, `/api/causal`, `/api/ft`, `/api/wcc`, `/api/components` | JSON endpoints behind the views |

## 5. Grafana — `python3 scripts/fish_dashboard_url.py <session_id>`

Prints a dashboard URL with the session's time range and variables pre-set
(PG panels + Tempo panels share the same absolute time axis).

## 6. One session, end to end

```bash
S=fish_20260817_172259
python3 postprocess/ingest_pg.py ~/fish_traces/$S
python3 -m postprocess.model_improved_pg --session $S --source-trace ~/fish_traces/$S
python3 postprocess/join_analysis.py --session $S          # optional
python3 postprocess/export_traces_tempo.py $S              # Gantt in Grafana
python3 scripts/fish_dashboard_url.py $S
# http://localhost:8783/wcc?session_id=$S   http://localhost:8783/components?session_id=$S
```

Reference sessions and what they demonstrate: `notes/cp_0.txt` (r11,
logging_simulator + bag), `notes/cp_1.txt` (r18, planning_simulator with a
goal — first closed loop; polled subscriptions), `notes/join_semantics_from_traces.txt`
(r9/r10b joins).
